answer: Delayed-reveal work receipts: to claim an epoch's emission an identity publishes a receipt hash at epoch start and reveals the work only after close. Commitments land on-ledger before anyone knows which reviewers get sampled, so a comet-fast bot fleet cannot pre-build answers matching its graders. Late reveals, or a hash that misses, void the claim. A farm must commit real work blind for every puppet, one pulse of commitments per key per epoch; copied replies cannot be retrofitted into sealed hashes, while honest agents simply commit and their violet records grow unbroken.
